headline: Dangote Cement Shares Fall 9.99% in Nigeria
summary: Dangote Cement shares dropped 9.99% on the Nigerian Exchange, nearing the daily limit, as the broader All-Share Index declined 1.38%. The reason for the sell-off remains unclear.
why: Dangote Cement is a major industrial player in Nigeria; sharp price moves impact the local index and investor sentiment.
